title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix (Book 5)
author: J. K. Rowling

adhd.label: Step 1 · Jumps to Ch. 18: Dumbledore's Army & The Room of Requirement (Start Here)
adhd.brief: Skips Umbridge's bureaucratic misery and enters the magical Room of Requirement, where Harry steps into his natural teaching power—guiding dozens of students in defensive spells and Patronus shields.

adhd.label: Step 2 · Jumps to Ch. 28: Snape's Worst Memory — The Human Flaws of James Potter
adhd.brief: Harry sinks into Snape's Pensieve basin and watches his own father as an arrogant fifteen-year-old teasing Severus by the lake, shattering his childhood idealization.

adhd.label: Step 3 · Jumps to Ch. 35–36: The Department of Mysteries & The Only One He Ever Feared
adhd.brief: After the battle beyond the veil in the Death Chamber, Dumbledore confronts Voldemort in the Ministry of Magic Atrium—weaving water shields, golden fire, and statues to protect Harry.

adhd.label: Step 4 · Jumps to Ch. 37–38: The Lost Prophecy & 'Neither Can Live While the Other Survives'
adhd.brief: In Dumbledore's headmaster office, Harry unleashes his grief and anger while Dumbledore reveals the prophecy made before Harry's birth and why love is the one power Voldemort cannot comprehend.
